author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
Hello Guys I´m NovaLikesPvP [ Or just Nova ] and  this is my appeal, please read it all.

Introduction.

Well, Today I´m appealing 3 punishments. First, I´m appealing this:
Iron Kick pleaes be respectful November 20, 2015 at 7:52 PM

The other punishment I´m appealing today is this:

 Fouled Tempban Excessively disrespectful. November 20, 2015 at 7:54 PM November 21, 2015 at 7:54 PM

And getting that two Infractions away, I would like to appeal My exccesive infractions appeal, because without that Infractions I would just nine infractions.

Tempban Excessive Infractions, December 26, 2015 at 8:42 PM.


Introduction to my Infractions.

Ok, So at this point ´ll explain about my 2 first Infractions.


Kick please be respectful November 20:

Well, on the November 20´s Night we´re playing an scrimmage between Apollo and my team Ethernal Cross.
We won vs Apollo on Rendezvous 3.5, When the match finished they started to say "We have a good surprise for you guys" Then, 1 minute later our Player Juanno was banned by "Riley" because of  ""Antiknoback"", ( Then he got unbanned btw ). Apollo´s mates started to laugh, and we get really furious because that wasn´t the first time we get a player false banned on Avicus, So we´re really raged.
Then, I said things that were´not even offensive or trying to get disrespectful of him, But he taked like that ( I have screenshots, This logs are on the evidence point ) . Then I got kicked by this mod, but for my good our players took some screenshots of the logs, that "apparentely" I talked him "disrespectuflly".

Exccesive Disrespecful November 20

This is a infraction that was 30 times worst than the other one.
When I got on the server, ( After I got kicked ) I asked why I was kicked, because I didn´t even said anything disrespectful to anyone, So, For things that anyone knows, I got tempbaned by Fouled for 1 day of "Excessive Disrespectful" When I didn´t even write something more """offensive""" after my kick, right now I can´t understand what did he thought at that minute ( Logs on "Evidence" Point ).


Evidence.

Kick

First, I´m giving you the first evidence Why I should take off my punishment [Kick].
The first Screenshot was taken by an Ethernal Cross player, Some seconds before I got kicked.
As you can see, I just said "Enjoy Your Mod" but Mods taked it like "offensive" because I was just "complaining offensivily" about the ban of Juanno.
https://gyazo.com/09d1c7ec73d0520ec3c8af62a4fd35f6
https://gyazo.com/6a81755dad565e3617efb44cfab5e5f7


Tempban

Now I´m giving you the evidence of my tempban, Of "Disrespecful"
On this case,  [After I got kicked ]  I  Joined the server and I asked Why I had been kicked, I didn´t said ANYTHING disrespectful to any mod, As you can see on this Screenshot.
https://gyazo.com/aca1555d0855203688d48e47fb0e5ec8
At this moment I can´t understand what I said to be tempbanned at that minute..


Excessive Infractions Tempban.

By appealing the first two infractions I´m appealing my excessive infractions tempban because Without that Infractions I would have 9 punishments, So I could have a second chance, please.




Facts

On the day I got kicked and tempbaned & Juanno got banned, I talked with grapesmoothies about the ban of Juanoo ( He got unbanned ) And also about my 2 infractions, He said that he was going to take them out, but I think he forgotted it, ( At that minute I didn´t care much about that infractions.. ).



Personal Opinion



I want to be really Respectful, And not biased to my own opinion or point of view. In my opinion maybe I get some rage on that Scrimage ( 20 November ) But It Was not THAT bad to punish me, it was not good. Also, This is not really important but, If Riley ( The mod ) Learn what is No Knoback this had never happen [ On the video that he uploaded there wasn´t no knoback, it was so obvious..




Thanks for reading my appeal, let me tell you that I didn´t wanted to be to someone disrespectful, Thank you for your time and help, I really appreciate it, And please do what you think, Thanks!






Regards.


NovaLikesPvP
Avicus Player

title: NovaLikesPvP - Appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Nova,

Your appeal is reviewing and i am currently going through the evidence, going through logs and questioning moderators. I will try to get this solved as soon as possible.
replies.body_tagged:

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Nova,

After looking through your logs i have established that your kick was unnecessary so that will be appealed. However in regards with the tempban that will not be appealed, you said more then nothing. You called the moderator a child and referred to all moderators as 9 year old kids . Therefore the tempban won't be appealed and therefore the Excessive infractions punishment will also not be appealed. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
